rows.rule_yaml:
title: Suspicious User-Space Executable Spawning CMD to Run Secondary Payload with
  IP Argument
id: 82c81095-d33d-5e90-bdf9-8184eb044207
status: experimental
description: Detects a non-system executable (e.g., GruntHTTP.exe) located in a user-writable
  directory (Desktop, Downloads, AppData) spawning cmd.exe to execute another suspicious
  executable from the same directory with an external IP address argument, indicative
  of malware execution chain.
author: Sentinel Loop rule_gen v0
date: '2026-10-04'
tags:
- attack.t1204.002
- attack.t1059.003
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection1:
    ParentImage|endswith:
    - \GruntHTTP.exe
    ParentImage|contains:
    - \Users\\
    - \Desktop\\
    - \Downloads\\
    - \AppData\\
    Image|endswith:
    - \cmd.exe
    CommandLine|contains|all:
    - /c
    - MoveExcel4.exe
  condition: 1 of selection*
falsepositives:
- Legitimate custom tools placed in user directories by developers or administrators
  (rare)
level: high
